style: Original 3D black comedy about pensions, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: white head feathers, glasses on a chain, big cobalt-blue vest. Hugs a HUGE shiny GOLD piggy bank, half his size, slot on its back, hole in its belly. Deadpan, never flies.
second_characters: ONE grinning mole boss, purple suit. THREE clerks, orange ties: white rabbit, ferret, beaver.
props: Piggy bank: goose's; its scarlet belly cork: mole's. Gold coins: from it into the mole's open cherry-red briefcase. Shovel: yellow handle, scarlet bow; mole's, then the goose's. Mole's sill: row of gold piggy banks tied with orange ties like the clerks'.
environment: Bright TURQUOISE glass tower; over its open 40th-floor window a wide navy sign, big white Cyrillic letters "БАНК РОССИИ", readable; pale lilac tile plaza, revolving glass door.
lighting: Noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, amber rim left, hot-pink rim right; gold, cobalt, white letters vivid.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice, lines exactly as written

timeline.a: From the first frame: gold coins gush into the lens from the piggy bank's belly; above, under the БАНК РОССИИ sign, the goose dangles outside, wing in the mole's farewell handshake; the mole's free paw holds the pulled scarlet cork.
timeline.c: flies up from the briefcase to the handshake under the sign, close-up

timeline.a: The mole lets go, waves bye; the goose drops, piggy bank hugged, coins spraying from the slot.
timeline.c: dives after him, waving paw in foreground

timeline.a: Falling, he snaps a flying coin in his beak, drops it back in the slot.
He hits the lilac tiles, sinks neck-deep, cracks ringing him.
The piggy bank cracks on his head into two empty gold halves; the last coin rolls away.
The rabbit grabs the coin, pats the goose's head with it, darts into the revolving door; ferret, beaver follow, pitying.
timeline.c: threads the door, legs in foreground

timeline.a: His wingtip presses the empty halves together; he hugs the mended piggy bank to his neck.
timeline.c: circles low round the piggy bank

timeline.a: Up top, under the БАНК РОССИИ sign, the mole throws the bowed shovel down like a spear; the goose jerks his head up.
At 7.90 the shovel skewers the mended piggy bank to the tiles a finger from his neck, halves bursting; he does not blink.
timeline.c: rides the blade down, hurls itself into his face, close-up

timeline.a: He hauls himself out by the handle, stands at attention, nods, beak free.
The mole pulls the cork from the next tied piggy bank; coins pour into his briefcase. Last frame: gold flood, orange-tied piggy banks, БАНК РОССИИ above.
timeline.c: soars past the sign into the briefcase, close-up
